notes.title: Update: Evil Pumpkin localization!
notes.content:
You can now play Evil Pumpkin in one of [b]6 new languages[/b]!

Languages available are:
- French
- Italian
- German
- Spanish
- Dutch
- Portuguese-Brazil

NOTE: If you already own the game, you need to start with a new profile. 

Cheers!

notes.title: Evil Pumpkin: The Lost Halloween Update Released
notes.content:
This is the list of [b]updates[/b]: 

[HIDDEN OBJECT SCENE] - Key for Treasure Chest Underwater in Casual Mode - bug fixed
[HIDDEN OBJECT SCENE] - Lego Block: minor fix in Orphanage Passage scene
[MINIGAME]  - Coffee tables: minigame popup updated and minigame redesigned 
[GAMEPLAY] - Bug fixed when you try to go back from Everywhere - Nowhere Portal 

Updates will be visible with New Profile created, and game will be updated automatically by Steam.
